latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Blockbuster Therapy Predictor – a tool to forecast the blockbuster potential of early-stage biotechnology platforms.

- Predictive scoring system analyzes clinical, patent, and funding data to rank emerging therapeutic technologies.
- Offers customizable analysis with technology filtering, thresholding, and console/JSON output options.
- Outputs include blockbuster index, technology maturity, market potential, momentum, and investment recommendations.
- Comprehensive documentation on methodology, usage, dependencies, evaluation, risks, and limitations.
- Uses mock data; real-time data integration planned for future updates.
